title: Concept: Reflective invocation via Activator.CreateInstance (csharp) — review required
description: In csharp, Activator.CreateInstance resolves code by name at runtime. The remedy is a fixed allow-list of types.
applicability: csharp runtime name resolution; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Selection of unintended code or classes when the name is attacker-influenced; MEDIUM because the call alone does not prove data flow.
